senses.definition: help given to someone, attention to their needs, caution, or a worry
senses.example: The children need care and attention.

senses.definition: to think something matters, feel concern, look after someone, or want something politely
senses.example: Would you care for some tea?

senses.definition: used to show uncertainty or make a gentle suggestion
senses.example: Perhaps we could leave a little earlier.

senses.definition: after the expected time, near the end of a period, or no longer alive
senses.example: We missed the bus because we were late.

senses.definition: after the usual time or near the end of a period
senses.example: We arrived late because of the traffic.

senses.zh: 硬的；困难的；严厉的；猛烈的
senses.definition: firm rather than soft, difficult, strict, or forceful
senses.example: The ground is too hard to dig.

senses.definition: with great effort, force, or intensity
senses.example: She worked hard to finish the report.
senses.note: hard 是努力地；hardly 通常是几乎不，不是 hard 的普通副词形式。

senses.zh: 田地；场地；领域；场；字段；参赛者群体
senses.definition: an area of land, a subject of work, a physical force area, a data entry, or the competitors in an event
senses.example: She works in the field of education.

senses.definition: to catch or stop a ball, provide a team or candidate, or deal with questions
senses.example: The manager fielded questions after the meeting.

senses.definition: in addition or instead; with or, if the stated condition is not met
senses.example: Is there anything else you need?

senses.zh: 经过；传递；通过；流逝；批准；去世（委婉）
senses.definition: to go by, hand something over, succeed in a test, let time go by, approve a rule, or die in a polite expression
senses.example: Could you pass me the salt?

senses.zh: 通行证；及格；传球；山口；一次经过
senses.definition: permission to enter, success in a test, a ball sent to a teammate, a route through mountains, or one movement past something
senses.example: Show your pass at the entrance.

senses.definition: having a particular role or state in the past but not now
senses.example: The former teacher now writes children's books.

senses.definition: the first of two people or things just mentioned
senses.example: Tea and coffee are both available, but I prefer the former.

senses.definition: to exchange for money, attract buyers, persuade someone to accept an idea, or betray someone
senses.example: She sells handmade bags online.

senses.definition: an attempt to persuade people to buy or accept something
senses.example: The new plan was a hard sell to the team.

senses.definition: very important or large, or connected with a musical scale often heard as bright
senses.example: The town needs major repairs after the storm.

senses.zh: 主修专业；主修生；少校；重要赛事
senses.definition: a main subject studied, a student of that subject, a military officer, or a top sports competition
senses.example: Her major is biology.

senses.definition: to choose a subject as the main focus of a college degree
senses.example: He majored in history at university.

senses.definition: on some occasions, but not always or regularly
senses.example: We sometimes have lunch in the park.

senses.definition: to need something or officially insist that someone do something
senses.example: This task requires patience.

senses.definition: following the length or direction of something, or at places beside it
senses.example: We walked along the river.

senses.definition: forward, together with someone, or brought with you
senses.example: You can bring a friend along.

senses.zh: 发展；开发；新进展；新建住宅区
senses.definition: growth or improvement, creating something new, a recent event, or a group of newly built homes
senses.example: The team reported a new development in the project.

senses.zh: 他们自己；她们自己；它们自己；本人
senses.definition: the same people or things as the subject; also used for one person when their gender is unknown or not specified
senses.example: The children made the cake themselves.

senses.zh: 报告；报道；传闻；成绩单；爆响
senses.definition: an account of facts or events, an unconfirmed story, a school progress record, or a sudden loud sound
senses.example: The report explains why the project was delayed.

senses.definition: to give information, tell authorities about wrongdoing, or arrive as instructed
senses.example: Please report any problems to the manager.

senses.definition: the part someone plays in a story, job, group, or situation
senses.example: Parents play an important role in children's learning.

senses.zh: 更好的；更合适的；好转的
senses.definition: of higher quality, more suitable, or healthier than before
senses.example: I feel much better after a good night's sleep.

senses.zh: 更好地；更成功地；更大程度地
senses.definition: in a more effective, suitable, or successful way
senses.example: I can hear you better now.

senses.definition: to improve something or do more successfully than someone else
senses.example: She hopes to better her previous result.

senses.zh: 更好者；更好情况（常用于短语）
senses.definition: someone or something of higher quality, or an improved situation
senses.example: The weather has changed for the better.

senses.zh: 经济的；经济学的；有经济效益的
senses.definition: connected with money, trade, or the economy, or making enough profit to be worth doing
senses.example: The report discusses economic growth.
senses.note: economic 多指经济的或有经济效益的；表示节省钱或资源通常用 economical。

senses.zh: 努力；费力；尝试；努力的成果
senses.definition: physical or mental energy, an attempt, or something produced through trying
senses.example: Learning a language takes time and effort.

senses.zh: 决定；作出判断；决定结果
senses.definition: to choose after thinking, reach a judgment, or determine an outcome
senses.example: We decided to take the train.

senses.zh: 比率；速度；价格标准；税费
senses.definition: a measure compared with time or another amount, a price, or a local charge on property
senses.example: The plants grow at a different rate.

senses.zh: 评价；划分等级；值得；看重
senses.definition: to judge quality, give a level, deserve attention, or think highly of something
senses.example: How would you rate the service?

senses.zh: 强壮的；坚固的；有力的；浓的；明显的
senses.definition: having physical power, being hard to break, having a great effect, or being intense in taste, smell, or belief
senses.example: The bridge is strong enough to carry heavy trucks.

senses.definition: able to happen or be done, or potentially suitable
senses.example: Is it possible to change the date?

senses.definition: a person or choice that could be suitable
senses.example: This small hotel is a possible for our trip.

senses.zh: 心脏；内心；核心；勇气；红桃
senses.definition: the organ that pumps blood, feelings, the central part, courage, or a playing-card suit
senses.example: She knows the poem by heart.

senses.definition: a substance used to treat illness or change how the body or mind works, sometimes illegally
senses.example: The doctor asked which drugs he was taking.

senses.definition: to give a substance that affects the body or mind, or secretly add it to food or drink
senses.example: The guard discovered that the drink had been drugged.

senses.zh: 领导者；领先者；首席演奏者；社论
senses.definition: a person or organisation in charge or ahead, the first violinist in an orchestra, or a newspaper's main opinion article
senses.example: The group chose a new leader.

senses.definition: what makes things visible, a device producing it, a flame, or information that helps understanding
senses.example: There is not enough light to read here.

senses.zh: 轻的；明亮的；浅色的；少量的；不严肃的
senses.definition: not heavy, dark, strong, or serious, or small in amount
senses.example: I packed a light jacket for the trip.

senses.definition: to start something burning or make a place brighter
senses.example: She lit a candle beside the window.

senses.zh: 嗓音；表达意见的权利；看法；语态
senses.definition: the sound made when speaking or singing, a right to speak, an expressed opinion, or a grammatical way to present an action
senses.example: Everyone should have a voice in the decision.

senses.definition: to express a feeling or opinion in words, or provide speech for a character
senses.example: Several parents voiced concerns about the plan.

senses.definition: a married woman in relation to her spouse
senses.example: His wife works at the local library.

senses.zh: 整个的；完整的；未受损的
senses.definition: complete, including every part, or not broken
senses.example: We spent the whole day at the museum.

senses.definition: all parts considered together as one thing
senses.example: The parts work together to form a whole.

senses.definition: the official organisation and people responsible for preventing crime and enforcing laws
senses.example: The police are asking for witnesses.
senses.note: police 指警方时通常用复数动词：The police are here。单个警察说 a police officer。

senses.zh: 维持治安；监管；监督执行
senses.definition: to maintain order in a place or check that people follow rules
senses.example: The event was carefully policed.

senses.zh: 头脑；心智；想法；记忆；意愿
senses.definition: the part of a person used to think and feel, or their thoughts, memory, or wishes
senses.example: I changed my mind after hearing her explanation.

senses.definition: to be bothered by something, pay attention, look after someone, or obey
senses.example: Would you mind opening the window?

senses.definition: after a long time, as the last point, or in a way that settles something
senses.example: We finally reached home after midnight.

senses.definition: to move something towards you, remove it, attract people, take something back, or injure a muscle by stretching it
senses.example: Pull the door towards you to open it.

senses.definition: a movement towards you, an attraction, or influence that can help get something done
senses.example: The pull of home was strong after a year abroad.

senses.zh: 返回；归还；回报；恢复；回应
senses.definition: to go or come back, give something back, repay, appear again, or respond
senses.example: Please return the book by Friday.

senses.zh: 返回；归还；回报；往返票；申报表
senses.definition: a coming or giving back, a reward or profit, a ticket both ways, or an official form showing financial details
senses.example: I need to complete my tax return this week.

senses.zh: 返回的；回程的；再次进行的
senses.definition: going back to a starting place or happening again in response
senses.example: The return journey took much less time.

senses.zh: 自由的；免费的；空闲的；未被占用的
senses.definition: not controlled, costing nothing, available, or not occupied
senses.example: Are you free for lunch tomorrow?

senses.definition: to release someone, remove a restriction, or make space or time available
senses.example: The new system frees staff from repeated paperwork.

senses.zh: 免费地；自由地；脱离束缚地
senses.definition: without payment, without control, or away from something holding you
senses.example: Children under five travel free.

senses.definition: connected with the armed forces or their activities
senses.example: He works at a military hospital.

senses.definition: the armed forces of a country, considered as a group
senses.example: She joined the military after college.

senses.definition: the money needed to buy something, or what must be given up to achieve a result
senses.example: The price includes delivery.

senses.definition: to decide or discover how much something costs
senses.example: The shop priced the bag at fifty pounds.

senses.zh: 较少的（常修饰不可数名词）
senses.definition: a smaller amount, used before a noun
senses.example: We should use less water.

senses.definition: a smaller amount of something already understood
senses.example: I ordered less than you did.

senses.definition: to a smaller degree or extent
senses.example: This route is less crowded.

senses.definition: after taking away a stated amount
senses.example: You will receive the total less the delivery charge.

数量限定改列 det.，比较程度为 adv.，意义保留；新增独立数量指代和扣除用法。

senses.zh: 根据；按照（用于 according to）
senses.definition: in the phrase according to, as stated by someone or depending on a rule, fact, or situation
senses.example: According to the timetable, the train leaves at six.
senses.note: 这里 prep. 标的是 according to 整个复合介词的作用；according 不能单独表示根据。不要漏写 to。

旧相符的不是本高频项的常见学习用法；按高频 according to 复合介词结构展示，并明确不能单独使用 according。

senses.definition: a choice made after thinking, the ability to choose firmly, or an official judgment
senses.example: We made the decision together.

senses.definition: to make something clear or give the reason why it happened
senses.example: Can you explain the rule to me?

senses.zh: 儿子；某地或群体出身的男子
senses.definition: a male child in relation to his parents, or a man associated with a place or group
senses.example: Their son starts school next year.

senses.definition: to want something to happen and believe it may be possible
senses.example: I hope you enjoy your trip.

senses.zh: 希望；期待；可寄托希望的人或物
senses.definition: a wish for something possible, a reason for expecting success, or someone who may bring it
senses.example: The good news gave us hope.

senses.zh: 发展；开发；形成；出现；患上；冲洗照片
senses.definition: to grow or improve, create or form something, begin to have a condition, or make a photograph visible
senses.example: The team is developing a new learning app.

senses.zh: 看法；景色；视野；观看；浏览量
senses.definition: an opinion, what can be seen, the ability to see it, or one act of looking at something
senses.example: The room has a lovely view of the river.

senses.definition: to look at something carefully or think of it in a certain way
senses.example: They view the change as an opportunity.

senses.definition: a connection between people or things, including a romantic partnership
senses.example: There is a clear relationship between sleep and attention.

senses.zh: 携带；搬运；承载；传播；刊登；售有；通过
senses.definition: to hold and move, support, spread, publish, have for sale, or win enough votes for a proposal
senses.example: This shop carries a wide range of books.

senses.zh: 搬运；携带；球的飞行距离
senses.definition: the act of holding and moving something, or the distance a ball travels through the air
senses.example: It is a short carry from the car to the house.

senses.zh: 城镇；市镇；市中心；城镇居民
senses.definition: a built-up place usually smaller than a city, its central area, or its people
senses.example: We live in a small town near the coast.

senses.definition: a way for vehicles or people to travel from one place to another
senses.example: The road to the village is narrow.

senses.definition: to control a vehicle, take someone by car, power a machine, or push a process forward
senses.example: She drives to work every day.

senses.zh: 开车出行；车程；动力；驱动器
senses.definition: a trip by car, the strong wish to achieve something, or a device that stores computer files
senses.example: It is a two-hour drive from here.

senses.zh: 手臂；扶手；臂状部分；武器（复数）
senses.definition: a part of the body from shoulder to hand, a supporting side part, or, in the plural, weapons
senses.example: She hurt her arm playing tennis.

senses.definition: to provide someone or something with weapons or with the things needed for a task
senses.example: The guards were armed with radios.

senses.zh: 真实的；正确的；忠诚的；真正的
senses.definition: based on fact, correct, loyal, or matching the real nature of something
senses.example: Is it true that the shop is closing?

senses.definition: relating to a system of government in which power is shared between a central government and states
senses.example: The case was heard in federal court.

senses.zh: 打破；弄坏；违反；中断；休息
senses.definition: to make something separate or stop working, fail to obey a rule, interrupt something, or stop work briefly
senses.example: Be careful not to break the glass.

senses.definition: a short time away from work, an interruption, or a gap in something
senses.example: Let's take a short break.

senses.definition: the way in which people or things are not the same, or a disagreement
senses.example: There is a big difference between the two plans.

senses.definition: to get something sent or given to you, experience a response, or welcome a visitor
senses.example: Did you receive my email?

senses.definition: to tell someone that you are grateful for something they did
senses.example: I thanked her for the ride.

senses.zh: 价值；重要性；价格；价值观
senses.definition: what something is worth, how useful it is, or a belief about what matters
senses.example: The house has increased in value.

senses.definition: to consider something important or judge how much it is worth
senses.example: We value your opinion.

senses.definition: involving, existing between, or working in several countries
senses.example: She works for an international company.

senses.definition: a structure with walls and a roof, or the activity of making one
senses.example: The building has ten floors.

senses.definition: something someone does, especially to deal with a problem, or movement of the body
senses.example: The school took action to improve safety.

senses.zh: 满的；充满的；完整的；吃饱的
senses.definition: containing as much as possible, complete, or having eaten enough
senses.example: The bus was full, so we waited for the next one.

senses.definition: a small copy, a type of product, a person showing clothes, or someone worth following
senses.example: The children built a model of the bridge.

senses.definition: to make a model of something, demonstrate an action, or show clothes professionally
senses.example: The teacher modelled the pronunciation first.

senses.definition: showing the standard that others should try to reach
senses.example: She was a model student.

author: root

senses.definition: to become part of a group, take part in an activity, connect things, or meet someone
senses.example: Would you like to join us for lunch?

senses.definition: the place where two parts are connected
senses.example: The join between the two boards is almost invisible.

notes: 名词“连接处”较少见；常见学习重点是动词。

senses.definition: one of the main periods of a year, or a time when an activity is common
senses.example: Spring is my favourite season.

senses.definition: to add flavour to food, or let material become ready for use over time
senses.example: Season the soup with a little salt.

senses.definition: people living together in an organized way, or an association of people with a shared interest
senses.example: Technology has changed society.

senses.definition: money that people or businesses must pay to the government
senses.example: They pay tax on their income.

senses.definition: to require payment of tax, or to place a heavy demand on someone or something
senses.example: The government taxes fuel heavily.

senses.definition: a person who manages an organization or a part of it, or guides the making of a film or play
senses.example: She is the director of the new film.

senses.definition: where someone or something is, the way a body is held, a job, or an opinion
senses.example: She applied for a new position.

senses.definition: to put someone or something in a particular place
senses.example: Position the chair near the window.

senses.zh: 运动员；玩家；演奏者；播放器
senses.definition: a person who takes part in a sport or game, plays music, or a device that plays recordings
senses.example: She is the best player on the team.

senses.zh: 同意；赞成；意见一致；商定
senses.definition: to have the same opinion, accept a suggestion, or decide something together
senses.example: We agreed to meet at six.

senses.definition: more than usual or more than other things
senses.example: I enjoy walking, especially in the morning.

senses.definition: written or stored information, the best result achieved, or a disc of recorded music
senses.example: Please keep a record of your expenses.

senses.definition: to write down information or store sound or images for later use
senses.example: We recorded the interview yesterday.

senses.definition: higher or greater than ever before
senses.example: The city had record temperatures this summer.

senses.definition: to choose something, remove fruit or flowers from a plant, or take something up
senses.example: You can pick any book you like.

senses.zh: 选择；选中的人或物；拨片
senses.definition: a choice, the person or thing chosen, or a small tool used to play a stringed instrument
senses.example: That restaurant is my top pick.

senses.definition: to have clothes or something else on your body, or to become thinner through use
senses.example: She wears a blue coat to school.

senses.definition: clothing for a particular purpose, or damage caused by long use
senses.example: The shoes show signs of wear.

senses.definition: material used for writing, a written document or study, or a newspaper
senses.example: Please write your name on this paper.

senses.definition: to cover a wall with paper, or hide a problem without solving it
senses.example: They papered over the cracks before selling the house.

senses.definition: different from the usual kind, important to someone, or made for a particular purpose
senses.example: Today is a special day for our family.

senses.definition: a product sold for less than usual, or a programme made for a particular occasion
senses.example: The café has a lunch special today.

senses.definition: an empty area, room for something, a gap, or the region beyond Earth
senses.example: There is enough space for another chair.

senses.definition: to arrange things with a distance between them
senses.example: Space the chairs two metres apart.

senses.zh: 地面；土地；场地；理由（复数）
senses.definition: the surface of the earth, land used for an activity, or reasons for an opinion or action
senses.example: The children sat on the ground.

senses.zh: 使停飞；罚不准出门；使搁浅
senses.definition: to stop an aircraft from flying, punish a child by keeping them at home, or leave a boat stuck on land
senses.example: The storm grounded all flights.

senses.definition: broken into very small pieces by grinding
senses.example: Add a little ground pepper.
senses.note: 形容词 ground 在这里是 grind 的过去分词，发音与名词相同。

senses.definition: the shape or type of something, a document to fill in, or a person's condition
senses.example: Please fill in this form.

senses.definition: to come into being, make a shape or group, or establish something
senses.example: They formed a new team.

senses.definition: help or agreement given to someone, or something that holds another thing up
senses.example: She received support from her family.

senses.definition: to help someone, agree with a plan, hold something up, or provide money for living
senses.example: Her parents support her decision.

senses.definition: something that happens, especially an important occasion or organized activity
senses.example: The school held a sports event.

senses.zh: 官方的；正式的；经批准的
senses.definition: connected with an authority or formally accepted by it
senses.example: The school made an official announcement.

senses.definition: a person who has a position of authority in an organization or government
senses.example: A government official spoke to reporters.

senses.definition: used before a noun to ask who owns something, or to connect a person or thing with something belonging to them
senses.example: Whose bag is this?

senses.definition: used without a following noun to ask who something belongs to
senses.example: Whose is this?

evidence.note: Learner's Dictionary lists pronoun and determiner.

senses.definition: a subject or situation being discussed, or the substance things are made of
senses.example: This is a matter we need to discuss.

senses.definition: to be important or have an effect
senses.example: It doesn't matter if we are a few minutes late.

senses.definition: every person in a group
senses.example: Everyone is welcome to join us.

author: root

senses.definition: the middle point or part of something, or a place where activities are organized
senses.example: The museum is in the center of town.

senses.definition: to put something in the middle or make something the main focus
senses.example: The course centers on practical speaking.

notes: 美式拼写；英式通常为 centre。

senses.definition: two people who are together, two things of the same kind, or a small number
senses.example: The couple moved into a new house.

senses.definition: to join two things together or link one thing with another
senses.example: The plan couples learning with daily practice.

senses.definition: a place where something is built or happens, or a place on the internet
senses.example: The new school site is near the station.

senses.definition: to choose a place for a building or put it there
senses.example: The new hospital will be sited near the river.

senses.definition: a planned piece of work with a particular aim
senses.example: Our class is doing a science project.

senses.definition: to send an image or voice outward, estimate a future result, or show a particular quality
senses.example: The figures project steady growth next year.

senses.definition: to strike something, come into contact with it, affect it badly, or reach a level
senses.example: The ball hit the window.

senses.zh: 打击；成功的事物；点击量
senses.definition: a blow, a popular song or product, or a recorded visit to a web page
senses.example: The new song was a big hit.

senses.definition: the lowest part of something, the main support for it, a place of operations, or a point in baseball
senses.example: The lamp has a heavy base.

senses.definition: to use something as the main source for a decision, or locate an activity somewhere
senses.example: The film is based on a true story.

senses.definition: showing a lack of good moral character
senses.example: It was a base act of betrayal.
senses.note: 形容词义较少见，主要先记名词“基础”和动词 be based on。

senses.definition: something people do, or a state in which something is happening
senses.example: Walking is a healthy activity.

senses.zh: 星星；恒星；明星；星形标记
senses.definition: a bright object in the night sky, a famous performer, or a shape with pointed arms
senses.example: We could see the stars clearly.

senses.definition: to have a main role in a film or show, or mark something with a star
senses.example: She stars in the new film.

senses.definition: a piece of furniture with a flat top, or data arranged in rows and columns
senses.example: Put the books on the table.

senses.zh: 提交讨论（英）；搁置讨论（美）；列成表格
senses.definition: in British English, to present an idea for discussion; in American English, to delay discussion; or to arrange data in rows
senses.example: The committee tabled the proposal.
senses.note: 英式 table a proposal 是“提交讨论”；美式常指“暂缓讨论”。读新闻时须看语境。

evidence.note: Cambridge distinguishes UK present for discussion and US postpone.

senses.definition: a place where legal cases are decided, an area for a ball game, or an open space beside a building
senses.example: The case went to court.

senses.definition: to try to gain someone's support or affection, or risk causing something unpleasant
senses.example: The company is courting new customers.

原数据的形容词义不属于现代常用 court；保留名词和动词。

senses.zh: 生产；制造；造成；拿出；制作节目
senses.definition: to make or grow something, cause a result, bring something out to show it, or organize a film or show
senses.example: The farm produces fresh vegetables.

senses.definition: food and other things grown on farms, especially fruit and vegetables
senses.example: The market sells fresh local produce.

evidence.note: Cambridge distinguishes verb and farm-product noun.
UK pronunciation differs by part of speech.

senses.definition: to put food in your mouth and swallow it, or gradually destroy a surface
senses.example: We eat dinner together most evenings.
